sources.title: Türkiye: Draft Law Threatens LGBT People with Prison | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (29 Oct 2025) on Türkiye's leaked draft 11th Judicial Package: amendments would criminalise conduct 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' under penal-code article 225 (up to 3 years), raise the minimum age for gender-affirming care to 25, expose trans people, care providers, civil-society organisations and journalists to charges, and penalise same-sex engagement or marriage ceremonies (up to 4 years); the package rides the 'Year of the Family' framing.

Kaos GL (24 Feb 2026) on its LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025, 'The Year of the Family: A Major Siege', launched in Ankara: institutionalised anti-LGBTI+ policy through 2025 — 'Year of the Family' instructions to public institutions, hate speech by senior officials and religious-administrative rhetoric; monitoring since 2007, built from media records and direct applications.
